desc: Implement DP using 2D arrays for current/next layers with dimensions parity (0/1) × sum range (~ -2000..2000) and product tracking up to limit.
For each sum and parity, store the maximum reachable product (≤ limit) to prune larger products.
Handle element 0 carefully: multiplying by 0 makes product 0, which is allowed; ensure DP updates don't discard it.
After processing all elements, look up max product for alternating sum exactly k across both parities; return -1 if no reachable product.
Write the final Solution class with `maxProduct` method and necessary imports.
Test the implementation with the provided examples to verify correctness.
Consider edge cases: all zeros, single element, negative `k`, `limit = 0` (though constraints say limit ≥ 1).
Verify that the offset correctly handles the maximum possible alternating sum magnitude.
